result.summary: The image depicts an urban mid-block environment with narrow sidewalks and parallel on-street parking on both sides. The streetscape is characterized by older brick buildings and a fenced vacant lot, lacking dedicated pedestrian safety infrastructure like mid-block crossings or traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars on both sides of the street block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic while improving the environment.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand exists, install a marked mid-block crossing with appropriate signage and lighting.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a wide, multi-lane roadway that lacks visible crossing infrastructure or traffic calming.
